q13.

The `store.Memo` struct (defined in `store/memo.go`) is referenced by the following files, all of which would need review:

```
store/memo.go
store/driver.go
store/db/mysql/memo.go
store/db/postgres/memo.go
store/db/sqlite/memo.go
server/notification/email.go
server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go
server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go
server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go
server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go
server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go
server/router/api/v1/common.go
server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go
server/router/api/v1/memo_batch_helpers.go
server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
server/router/rss/rss.go
server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
```

Grouped by package, the review surface is:
- `store` (declaration + driver interface)
- `store/db/mysql`, `store/db/postgres`, `store/db/sqlite` (per-dialect persistence)
- `server/router/api/v1` (largest cluster — service, converters, and helpers)
- `server/notification`
- `server/router/rss`
- `server/runner/memopayload`

Two caveats from the graph: `~writes`/`~reads` edges are a lower bound because SQL built by string concatenation isn't captured, so verify the driver call sites in `store/db/*/memo.go` directly; and this IR set carries no override/event/route edges, so any struct usage reached only through those relationships wouldn't appear here.
